Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred that the next town after Mummulgum on the Bruxner Highway was Lismore (on the Wilsons River) instead of Casino (on the Richmond River). This unverified assumption diverted the search toward Wilsons River and caused repeated, redundant confirmation attempts, rather than verifying the road sequence and identifying Casino’s location on the Richmond River.
